description: Walk a local repo (compose, Dockerfiles, k8s, terraform, package manifests, datastore and HTTP-client usage) and return a proposed OFK C4 workspace as DSL, with evidence per unit. Deterministic, offline; review the proposal before committing it.

maxFiles.description: Cap on files scanned. Defaults to 2000.

name.description: System name; defaults to the repo directory name.

path.description: Absolute or cwd-relative path to the repository root.

name: discover_architecture
title: Discover architecture from a repository
